summary: Both badge readers stopped accepting staff cards for a full morning
story: From 07:30 the entrance badge readers at Westhill rejected every staff card, and the site opened late at 11:40 after an engineer arrived. The readers show power and network, and the site rebooted them twice without change. The desk took the report at 07:52. Westhill is on the priority tier and asks the desk to escalate the reader fault.

items.description: Diagnose both badge readers with the site lead

documents.name: Reader fault log from the site
